items.stem: What must an entity prepare at its date of transition to IFRS?

options.text: An opening IFRS statement of financial position
options.rationale: Correct: an opening IFRS statement of financial position is prepared at the transition date.

options.text: A final local-GAAP statement with no changes
options.rationale: The opening balance sheet is restated to IFRS.
A full opening IFRS statement of financial position is required, not just cash flows.

options.text: A tax return for the transition year
options.rationale: A tax return is not the IFRS 1 requirement.

items.explanation: Correct: an opening IFRS statement of financial position is prepared at the transition date.

items.stem: Which TWO features characterise the IFRS 1 approach to first-time adoption? (Select TWO.)

options.text: IFRS are generally applied retrospectively as if they had always been used
options.rationale: Correct: the general principle is retrospective application.

options.text: Certain mandatory exceptions and optional exemptions modify full retrospective application
options.rationale: Correct: IFRS 1 provides mandatory exceptions and optional exemptions.

options.text: Comparative figures may be left under previous GAAP
options.rationale: Comparatives are restated to IFRS, not left under previous GAAP.

options.text: No reconciliations are required from previous GAAP
options.rationale: Reconciliations of equity and profit are required.

items.explanation: Correct: the general principle is retrospective application.

items.stem: A first-time adopter applies the deemed-cost exemption, treating it as compulsory for all its assets. Why is this a misunderstanding?

options.text: Deemed cost is an optional exemption the entity may choose, not a mandatory requirement
options.rationale: Correct: deemed cost is an optional exemption, not compulsory.

options.text: Deemed cost must be applied to every asset by law
Deemed cost is a mandatory exception that cannot be avoided
options.rationale: It is an optional exemption, not a mandatory exception.

options.text: Deemed cost only applies to liabilities
options.rationale: It applies to certain assets, and it is optional.

items.explanation: Correct: deemed cost is an optional exemption, not compulsory.
